tagline: Time and weather for your Chilkey ND104 display
welcome.update_text: Your settings and API keys are kept.
welcome.reinstall: nd104-sync {version} is already installed. Install it again to repair it.
welcome.downgrade: nd104-sync {from} is installed – this setup contains the older version {to}. Your settings are kept, but older versions may not know newer options.
welcome.msi: nd104-sync is also installed for all users (MSI). Remove one of them in Windows "Apps" so it does not run twice.
welcome.no_payload: This setup was built without nd104-sync and cannot install it.
disclaimer: Unofficial tool, not affiliated with Chilkey. By installing you accept the {license}.
uninstall.title: Uninstall nd104-sync {version}?
uninstall.text: The app, its shortcuts and the autostart entry are removed.
uninstall.keep_hint: Unticked, the settings, stored API keys and logs are deleted as well.
done.updated_text: nd104-sync {version} is running again – see the tray icon.
done.uninstalled_kept: Your settings were kept for a later installation.
done.tray: nd104-sync runs in the system tray, next to the clock.
hint.keyboard: Connect your keyboard with the USB cable – time and weather are only sent over the cable, not over 2.4 GHz or Bluetooth.
error.title: Something went wrong
error.install: nd104-sync could not be installed. Your previous installation was left unchanged.
error.uninstall: nd104-sync could not be removed completely. Close nd104-sync and try again.
webview2.title: nd104-sync Setup
webview2.question:
nd104-sync needs the Microsoft Edge WebView2 Runtime, which is missing on this PC.

Download and install it from Microsoft now?
webview2.failed: The WebView2 Runtime could not be installed. Please install it from microsoft.com and run the setup again.
